name: appflow
description: Welcome to the Amazon AppFlow API reference.

subcommands.name: cancel-flow-executions
subcommands.description: Cancels active runs for a flow.

subcommands.name: create-connector-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a new connector profile associated with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-flow
subcommands.description: Enables your application to create a new flow using Amazon AppFlow.

subcommands.name: delete-connector-profile
subcommands.description: Enables you to delete an existing connector profile.

subcommands.name: delete-flow
subcommands.description: Enables your application to delete an existing flow.

subcommands.name: describe-connector
subcommands.description: Describes the given custom connector registered in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: describe-connector-entity
subcommands.description: Provides details regarding the entity used with the connector, with a description of the data model for each field in that entity.

subcommands.name: describe-connector-profiles
subcommands.description: Returns a list of connector-profile details matching the provided connector-profile names and connector-types.

subcommands.name: describe-connectors
subcommands.description: Describes the connectors vended by Amazon AppFlow for specified connector types.

subcommands.name: describe-flow
subcommands.description: Provides a description of the specified flow.

subcommands.name: describe-flow-execution-records
subcommands.description: Fetches the execution history of the flow.

subcommands.name: list-connector-entities
subcommands.description: Returns the list of available connector entities supported by Amazon AppFlow.

subcommands.name: list-connectors
subcommands.description: Returns the list of all registered custom connectors in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-flows
subcommands.description: Lists all of the flows associated with your account.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the tags that are associated with a specified flow.

subcommands.name: register-connector
subcommands.description: Registers a new custom connector with your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: reset-connector-metadata-cache
subcommands.description: Resets metadata about your connector entities that Amazon AppFlow stored in its cache.

subcommands.name: start-flow
subcommands.description: Activates an existing flow.

subcommands.name: stop-flow
subcommands.description: Deactivates the existing flow.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Applies a tag to the specified flow.

subcommands.name: unregister-connector
subcommands.description: Unregisters the custom connector registered in your account that matches the connector label provided in the request.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes a tag from the specified flow.

subcommands.name: update-connector-profile
subcommands.description: Updates a given connector profile associated with your account.

subcommands.name: update-connector-registration
subcommands.description: Updates a custom connector that you've previously registered.

subcommands.name: update-flow
subcommands.description: Updates an existing flow.
